title.zh: US, UK launch joint alliance targeting crypto scam centers
title.en: US, UK launch joint alliance targeting crypto scam centers

current_state.zh: The US and UK formed a joint law enforcement alliance, signing a first-of-its-kind agreement to conduct parallel investigations and share information targeting crypto and cyber-enabled investment fraud scam centers.
current_state.en: The US and UK formed a joint law enforcement alliance, signing a first-of-its-kind agreement to conduct parallel investigations and share information targeting crypto and cyber-enabled investment fraud scam centers.
